The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.

The central conflict in the text is an ethical dilemma faced by Captain Reyes and her crew. They must choose between adhering to the Prime Directive, which prohibits interference with undeveloped civilizations, and acting to save an alien species whose planet is facing imminent destruction. This creates an internal struggle between the moral obligation to prevent harm and the imperative to follow established rules regarding non-interference.
